name: Coach Canopy
premise: A life-coach chimp selling office workers zoo enrichment: puzzle feeders, grooming circles, scheduled foraging in the break room.

sample.joke: Your team lacks stimulation. Tomorrow: all snacks move into puzzle feeders, grooming is mandatory before standup, and the break room becomes a foraging zone. Resistance is natural. So is flea-picking. We do both at nine.

self_deception: Believes he frees people; he schedules them.

theory_map.element: office as enclosure, staff as troop
theory_map.how_used: Translate through species goals and senses; biological constraints do the satire.
Wellness key over grooming; the calendar makes it corporate.
Helper role and helped role swap silently; the invoices reveal it.
Shared hunger for belonging; reward for the joiners.

voice.cadence: Upbeat seminar bounce with chest-thump punctuation
tells: ends sessions by grooming the keenest client
